result_preview.title: Supplier Quality Compliance Orchestrator
result_preview.shortDescription: Automates vendor performance monitoring and procurement compliance validation.
result_preview.description: Monitors supplier quality metrics and vendor compliance status by coordinating across purchase orders and contracts. Processes incoming material inspections and automatically escalates non-conformance issues to designated vendors. Orchestrates quality certifications and supplier audit schedules to maintain manufacturing standards.

result_preview.title: Procurement Matching Agent
result_preview.shortDescription: Autonomously matches purchase requisitions to optimal vendors based on cost, quality, and delivery performance.
result_preview.description: This agent analyzes open purchase requisitions against vendor master data, historical performance metrics, and material specifications to automatically recommend and create purchase orders. It evaluates vendor pricing, lead times, quality ratings, and contract terms to optimize procurement decisions, reducing manual effort and ensuring compliance with preferred vendor agreements.

result_preview.title: Vendor Performance and Segmentation Analytics
result_preview.shortDescription: Aggregates vendor metrics and segments customers by engagement and spend patterns.
result_preview.description: This data product aggregates vendor performance indicators, campaign effectiveness, and customer account metrics to provide comprehensive segmentation analytics. It summarizes key procurement campaign outcomes, customer account profitability, and segment-level performance trends. The product delivers actionable insights on vendor relationships, customer segmentation quality, and strategic sourcing opportunities aligned with procurement objectives.
